rules.sentence: This activity explains when this condition should be considered in a differential diagnosis, articulates how to properly evaluate for this condition, and highlights the role of the interprofessional team in caring for patients with this condition.

Treatment consists of a prolonged antibiotic course, but usually results in uncomplicated resolution of symptoms; however, delay in treatment or misdiagnosis can lead to significant morbidity and mortality.
